name: tune-guided
note: S-TUNER-GOAL-FLOW (operator friction 2026-09-12): the Tune tab runs a deterministic GUIDED loop - Start targets the lowest string, the runway reads the approach from the flat side, arrival must be SUSTAINED (holdMs) before the string lands, the landed string wears a check on the progress row, the flow auto-advances to the next string, and tapping a string button retargets. Headless Chromium has no microphone, so the scenario drives the SAME TuneFlow + render path through Tuner._sim (start/feed/state) - the mic only supplies cents frames; everything from cents to pixels is the production code. RED on main: the hook, the runway and the guided loop do not exist there.

evalAssert.js: (function(){ window.Tuner._sim.start(); var s = window.Tuner._sim.state(); return s.phase === 'approach' && s.index === 0; })()
evalAssert.label: Start targets the lowest string in approach
first string button is lit as the current target

evalAssert.js: (function(){ var S = window.Tuner._sim, t = 0; for (var i = 0; i < 20; i++) { S.feed(-30 + i, t); t += 16; } var s = S.state(); return s.phase === 'approach' && s.hint === 'flat'; })()
evalAssert.label: flat frames keep the flow in approach with a flat hint

evalAssert.js: (function(){ var p = document.getElementById('micPuck').getBoundingClientRect(), q = document.getElementById('micPost').getBoundingClientRect(); return p.left + p.width / 2 < q.left; })()
evalAssert.label: puck sits on the flat side of the post

evalAssert.js: (function(){ var S = window.Tuner._sim, t = 1000; for (var i = 0; i < 19; i++) { S.feed(0, t); t += 16; } var s = S.state(); return s.phase === 'arriving' && !s.progress[0]; })()
evalAssert.label: 300 ms in the zone is arriving, not landed

evalAssert.js: (function(){ var S = window.Tuner._sim, t = 1310; for (var i = 0; i < 25; i++) { S.feed(0, t); t += 16; } var s = S.state(); return s.phase === 'landed' && s.progress[0] === true; })()
evalAssert.label: sustained arrival lands the string

evalAssert.js: (function(){ var S = window.Tuner._sim, t = 1800; for (var i = 0; i < 40; i++) { S.feed(null, t); t += 16; } var s = S.state(); return s.phase === 'approach' && s.index === 1; })()
evalAssert.label: after the celebration the flow advances to the A string
progress row: A lit, E checked

evalAssert.js: (function(){ var s = window.Tuner._sim.state(); return s.index === 3 && s.phase === 'approach'; })()
evalAssert.label: tapping a string button retargets

evalAssert.js: (function(){ var S = window.Tuner._sim, t = 3000; for (var i = 0; i < 20; i++) { S.feed(12, t); t += 16; } return document.getElementById('micRunway').classList.contains('sharp'); })()
evalAssert.label: overshoot reads sharp on the runway
